finding: Current verifier rejects every custom role, additional provider user messages and every intermediate stop, even if same-worker SDK consumed canonical STEER/FOLLOW_UP. A bounded source-qualified extension is required to implement originalD02/D03; it must not bypass acceptance.
requirements: Select stream branch only from canonical readonly source-bound MODEL_SSE_V1 evidence reconstructed inside both acceptance snapshots, not output tags, task fields or worker flags. Unsupported/missing/invalid stream evidence fails rather than falls back into a permissive path. Legacy nonstream/qualification behavior and guards remain identical.

Bind each researchos.command.v1 custom message to exact admitted command ID, stable message ID, principal/project/session/task/run/epoch/generation, queue sequence, full original text+attachment refs/bytes and content hash; require actual canonical CONSUMED receipt and actual SDK order. SDK_ACCEPTED, ENQUEUED, UNKNOWN, DROPPED or cancelled unconsumed rows cannot become executable history. Same text under different commands stays distinguishable.

All recorded commands reconcile: executable custom messages each correspond to exactly one canonical consumed command, and each consumed command is represented once. Admission order may differ from SDK consumption; use actual consumption order and causal request boundary, not wall time or order inferred from unrelated table rowids.

Normalize only the already validated custom type to the exact pinned SDK user representation. Preserve complete text/attachment ordering and SDK conversion rules; exclude command metadata from instruction content. No generic custom-role fallback or arbitrary system-message normalization. Provider wire history before each MODEL must equal all exact preceding validated SDK history, retaining initial frozen task prompt/history and fixed system context.

An intermediate successful stop is allowed only when at least one newly actually consumed canonical STEER/FOLLOW_UP occurs at that boundary and explains the next bounded MODEL call. Missing continuation, duplicate consumption, fake stop, free-standing additional user message or unexplained nextMODEL fails. Final call retains successful stop. Normal tool-call continuation still requires every existing confirmed tool fact/order/result.

Preserve every original native dispatch/profile/source/request reservation bound, PREPARED/STARTED/CONFIRMED complete effect chain, original raw SSE seal and parsed assistant/tool comparison, declared tools, unique tool IDs, exact budget ledgers and unknown money handling. Keep configured max_calls and original hard limit32, qualification tighter bounds, final Run gates and all unused-message/effect rejection. No earlyPASS or label-based acceptance.

Partial interrupted transcript can be visible OBSERVED underD02 but cannot PASS verifyMuTurn; no END/LIVE/formal acceptance from transport credit, ordinaryACK or queue admission. Stream prefix/outbox/reconciliation remains independently verified.

Meaningful tests: trueSDK consumed STEER and FOLLOW_UP within original finite run; identical text/different IDs; actual admission-versus-consumption order difference; mutations of every command binding/raw/body/effect/history/order/budget and extra/omitted messages fail; original legacy positives/negatives retain results. source snapshots before/after verification must include new canonical consumption facts.
